text:
Sophie: Heads-up from Acme 3 their pilot vendor launched a low-latency embeddings feature and Acme says matching that is a gating factor. Can we decide: quick parity shim vs long-term differentiated tier? Need call by EOD.

Devon: Do we have the competitor numbers? If it's small pilot traffic, a shim (prefix caching + model quantization) could be a fast path.

Alex: Quick lab runs: q8 embedder cuts cost ~30% but p95 increases ~40ms vs float. With batch=8 and continuous batching p95 ~110ms on a single A100. Multi-tenant tests push p95 ~130ms.

Priya: From Acme: they want ~2x embed throughput relative to what they demoed. If we hit parity they'll sign the pilot.

Marcus: Options: (1) parity shim - fastest to close pilot, but adds short-term tech debt; (2) productize a low-latency embeddings tier - more robust, longer lead.

Sophie: My recommendation: hybrid. Ship a limited, pilot-scoped shim to win the deal, while kicking off a product track for a proper tier. Shim launch criteria: p95 <120ms on pilot traffic, documented migration, telemetry segmentation.

Devon: Eng estimate: ~2 sprints to harden shim (autoscaler tuning, KV prefix cache, kernel flags). Pilot likely needs Dedicated GPUs to avoid noisy neighbor variance.

Alex: Local command I used: `./run_embed --model rwd-embed-small-q8 --batch 8 --kv-cache true --continuous-batching` observed p95 ~110ms on A100-40G. Note: multi-tenant cluster tests hit ~130ms.

Priya: I'll tell Acme we can do a canary with those targets but we need their concurrency/QPS expectations to size Dedicated.

Marcus: We'll cap scope: pilot-only rollout, auto-sunset after 90 days unless productized. Define success metrics: pilot conversion, real p95 delta vs competitor, cost per embed.

Sophie: Action items: Devon+Alex -> write shim spec + infra needs (include Dedicated capacity request + fallback). Priya -> get Acme QPS and written gating. Marcus -> write the sunset clause and success metrics. I'll book 30m to finalize.

pm-bot: Meeting: #product-sync today 16:00 UTC - https://cal.example/meet/abc123

Devon: Posting spike checklist and perf plan in a sec.

Alex: Uploading reproducible notebook and raw p95 measurements (110ms local, 130ms multi-tenant). Also will paste kernel toggle snippet.

Priya: Legal note 3 if we promise a faster tier they want SLA language; that could slow contracting. cc @Marcus

Sophie: Ok. If no objections, I'll mark shim canary as high priority next sprint. Product-tier becomes parallel lower-priority project.

Devon: No objections. Infra is onboard.

Marcus: Agree, but insist on guardrails and sunset automation before greenlight.

Alex: Don't forget tracing hooks to tag pilot traffic so we can measure real-world p95 and cost-per-request for product decision.

Sophie: Good call. I'll update the roadmap board after the 16:00 sync and share notes here.
